_note: Cleric (2024), a full caster. Reconstructed from shipped generated data; Arcana Domain is Arcana Unleashed (mechanics + original descriptions).

classes.name: Cleric
startingEquipment: Chain Shirt, Shield, Mace, Holy Symbol, Priest's Pack, 7 GP
classes.flavor: A divine agent who channels a god's power to heal, smite, and turn the undead — a versatile caster and stalwart support.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You cast Cleric spells using Wisdom, preparing a growing list (shown on the table) plus cantrips from the full Cleric list each day. Save DC is 8 + Wisdom modifier + proficiency bonus; attack bonus is Wisdom modifier + proficiency bonus. You use a Holy Symbol as your focus.

features.name: Divine Order
features.description: Choose your calling: Protector (proficiency with Martial weapons and Heavy armor) or Thaumaturge (an extra Cleric cantrip, and you add your Wisdom modifier to Arcana and Religion checks).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: You can channel divine energy a number of times per rest (shown on the table; regain one on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest). Options: Divine Spark — a Magic action to heal a creature or deal Radiant/Necrotic damage (a save for half), scaling with level; and Turn Undead — force nearby Undead to make a Wisdom save or be Frightened and forced to flee.

features.name: Sear Undead
features.description: When you use Turn Undead, you also deal Radiant damage (a number of d8s equal to your Wisdom modifier) to each Undead that fails its save.

features.name: Blessed Strikes
features.description: Choose one: Divine Strike (once per turn, add 1d8 Radiant or Necrotic damage to a weapon hit) or Potent Spellcasting (add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your Cleric cantrips).

features.name: Divine Intervention
features.description: As a Magic action you can cast any Cleric spell of level 5 or lower without expending a slot or providing Material components. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Improved Blessed Strikes
features.description: Your Blessed Strikes choice improves — the extra damage increases and, for Potent Spellcasting, once per turn you can also grant Temporary HP.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two by 1 (max 20), or take a feat. Repeats at 8th, 12th, and 16th level.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for. Boon of Fate is a fitting choice.

features.name: Greater Divine Intervention
features.description: Your Divine Intervention can now produce the effect of any Cleric spell, and once per Long Rest you can use it without expending its normal use.

subclasses.name: Life Domain
subclasses.flavor: A healer channeling the positive energy of life itself, mending wounds better than any other.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.description: Whenever a level 1+ spell restores HP to a creature, it regains extra HP equal to 2 + the spell's level. You also gain Life Domain spells always prepared (Bless, Cure Wounds, and more as you level).

features.name: Preserve Life
features.description: A Channel Divinity option: as a Magic action you restore HP equal to five times your Cleric level, divided among creatures within 30 feet, up to half each one's HP maximum.

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.description: When you cast a level 1+ spell that restores HP to another creature, you also regain HP equal to 2 + the spell's level.

features.name: Supreme Healing
features.description: When you would roll dice to restore HP with a spell, you instead use the highest possible number for each die.

subclasses.name: Light Domain
subclasses.flavor: A cleric of a sun or fire god who scorches foes with radiance and blinds the wicked.

features.name: Radiance of the Dawn
features.description: You gain the Light cantrip and Light Domain spells (Burning Hands, Faerie Fire, and more). Warding Flare: as a Reaction you can impose Disadvantage on an attack against you or a nearby creature. Radiance of the Dawn (Channel Divinity): dispel magical darkness and deal Radiant damage to enemies within 30 feet (a Constitution save for half).

features.name: Improved Warding Flare
features.description: You regain all uses of Warding Flare on a Short Rest, and when you use it you also grant the protected creature Temporary HP.

features.name: Corona of Light
features.description: As a Magic action you emit an aura of sunlight for 1 minute; enemies in it have Disadvantage on saves against spells that deal Fire or Radiant damage.

subclasses.name: Trickery Domain
subclasses.flavor: A cleric of mischief and misdirection who conjures duplicates and blesses allies with stealthy cunning.

features.name: Invoke Duplicity
features.description: You gain Trickery Domain spells (Charm Person, Disguise Self, and more) and Blessing of the Trickster (grant a creature Advantage on Stealth). Invoke Duplicity (Channel Divinity): create an illusory duplicate of yourself for 1 minute that you can move and cast spells through, and that gives you Advantage on attacks against creatures near it.

features.name: Trickster's Transposition
features.description: When you or your Invoke Duplicity illusion would be targeted, you can swap places with the duplicate as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Improved Duplicity
features.description: Your Invoke Duplicity is stronger — allies near the illusion gain benefits, and when it ends you can heal creatures near it.

subclasses.name: War Domain
subclasses.flavor: A martial priest who leads the charge, guiding weapons with divine will and fighting like a seasoned soldier.

features.name: Guided Strike
features.description: You gain proficiency with Martial weapons and Heavy armor and War Domain spells (Divine Favor, Shield of Faith, and more). War Priest: make an extra weapon attack as a Bonus Action a number of times per rest. Guided Strike (Channel Divinity): add +10 to one attack roll after seeing it.

features.name: War God's Blessing
features.description: You can expend a use of Channel Divinity to cast Shield of Faith or Spiritual Weapon without a spell slot.

features.name: Avatar of Battle
features.description: You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

subclasses.name: Arcana Domain
subclasses.flavor: A cleric of gods tied to knowledge, secrecy, and power, who treats magical lore not as personal power but as a gift to be shared and protected.

features.name: Arcana Domain Spells
features.description: You always have domain spells prepared at the listed Cleric levels: Detect Magic, Magic Missile, Magic Weapon, and Nystul’s Magic Aura at 3; Counterspell and Dispel Magic at 5; Arcane Eye and Leomund’s Secret Chest at 7; Bigby’s Hand and Teleportation Circle at 9.

features.name: Modify Magic
features.description: When you cast a spell, you can expend a use of Channel Divinity (no action required) to alter it: Fortifying Spell gives one target 2d8 + your Cleric level Temporary HP, or Tenacious Spell makes a creature that saves against the spell roll 1d6 and subtract it from its first save against the effect.

features.name: Student of Arcana
features.description: You gain proficiency in Arcana (or another Cleric skill), and you learn two Wizard cantrips, swappable when you gain a Cleric level.

features.name: Dispelling Recovery
features.description: Right after you cast a spell with a slot that restores HP or ends a condition, you can cast Dispel Magic as part of that same action/Bonus Action/Reaction without a slot. Once per Short or Long Rest, or restore it by expending a use of Channel Divinity.

features.name: Magical Mastery
features.description: You learn four Wizard spells — one each of levels 6, 7, 8, and 9 — and always have them prepared, replacing one with another Wizard spell of the same level whenever you gain a Cleric level.
